claimed_mechanism: This architecture escapes the local no-go (DC-013) by making the MOND force law spatially nonlocal via an auxiliary Legendre chi, while supplying the required lensing (Psi != Phi) through a locally screened preferred-frame slip. The stiff vector u_mu is strictly non-propagating (kinetic: none), providing a reference frame but no physical degrees of freedom, thus avoiding the 6-DOF aether ghosts of DC-002. Crucially, the PPN slip is proportional to e^-y, but the kinetic normalization of the spatial metric and the auxiliary chi is independent (fixed by the spatial Einstein-Hilbert term and a bare mass scale), breaking the P7 degeneracy that killed the khronometric model.
inequivalence_argument: Unlike DC-012 (frameless localized nonlocal), this theory is not frameless; it contains a stiff vector u_mu that mediates the lensing slip. Unlike DC-010 (khronometric MOND), the preferred-frame field u_mu has zero kinetic term (is a fixed background/stiff aether) rather than being a propagating khronon with kinetic normalization controlled by the screening coefficient. Unlike FM-000004, the longitudinal mode of u_mu does not exist to be strongly coupled; u_mu is purely algebraic/background. It avoids DC-001 by being nonlocal in the MOND sector and having a preferred frame.
name: Kinetic-Orthogonal Stiff-Aether Nonlocal MOND (KOSAM)
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field MOND regime, the nonlocal chi enforces the correct g(a_0) force law. The e^-y screened frame coupling generates a constant fractional slip (Phi - Psi) that is suppressed in the solar system (y >> 1) but active in galaxies, yielding the correct gamma_PPN = 1 and avoiding the under-lensing of frameless theories. Because u_mu is degenerate, it does not introduce a propagating scalar mode whose sound speed could vanish.
